criteria.criterion: The reverted scanner artifacts are recreated/adapted within the recorded 21-path impact.
`review-scanners.lock.json` has independent linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 entries with exact Gitleaks URLs and SHA-256 values from release checksums.
Each platform entry points to a resolved Semgrep requirements lock with the same Semgrep version and required hashes; installer uses `pip install --require-hashes`.
Docker review-bot selects/validates linux/arm64; reusable Linux x64 CI selects/validates linux/amd64.
Installer rejects unsupported platform, missing scanner, wrong Gitleaks version/digest, and invalid Semgrep hashes before contracts run.
Valid locks allow explicit native scanner contracts; default local tests and unsupported local platforms skip with reasons and do not provision scanners.
A test verifies `bin/semgrep` remains executable when installation uses a relative `.tools/review-scanners` prefix from another working directory.
Generated `docs/security.md` names the manifest as update authority, checksum source, per-platform bump example, and withdrawn-asset recovery procedure.
Regeneration leaves `docs/config-reference.md` with no unexpected drift.
`_scanner-integration.yml` carries the b973 predates guard and the Make recipe is POSIX-dash-safe under the parity tests.
`scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` documents `scanner-integration` as an ADR-0114 advisory exception.
`tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py` accepts explicitly justified scanner CI-step mechanisms without requiring baseline promotion.

Gerrit scanner wiring is non-voting/non-blocking: separate workflow, outside `gerrit-verify.yaml`, outside `vote.needs`, outside vote normalization, and outside required workflow-conclusion aggregation.

Mirror CI may run the reusable scanner lane for visibility, and the separate Gerrit advisory workflow may run on all dispatched patchsets, but Gerrit `Verified` voting remains governed only by the existing aggregate.

citation.description: No OpenGrep integration, no new Docker-image build steps in CI, scanner not added to make lint, and default local tests skip scanner contracts via skipif markers when scanners aren't installed.

criteria.criterion: OpenGrep, Docker-image builds, normal `make lint`, and default local tests remain outside scope.
Cold-run cost is documented at about 1.5-3 runner-minutes without extending the 22-23 minute critical path when capacity is available.
